data.locator: Table 6 (empirical means); Table 7 (T1 model input); Appendix 2 (T1 fit expression and diagnostics).
data.source_setting: One private hospital emergency department in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil; nurse triage, daytime shift T1.
data.source_period: Records span 2022-02-01 to 2023-09-30, excluding August 2023; fitting window not specified.
data.source_n: 130,525 total attendances over 19 months; triage duration missing 55.07%; fitting sample n not reported.
data.quantity: T1 triage time: empirical mean versus two printed shifted-lognormal model inputs
data.parameterization: Expressions copied as printed. ARENA guide defines LOGN parameters as mean and standard deviation of the unshifted lognormal variate; adding 1.5 implies means of 3.36 and 2.55 minutes, respectively. These derived means are arithmetic implications, not values reported by the article.
data.fit_method: Article says Input Analyzer selected fits; Table 7 and Appendix 2 disagree on T1 expression. The exact fitting subset and handling of missingness are not reported.
data.source_evidence_basis: Inspected publisher-hosted full-text PDF. Table 6 reports T1 triage mean 3.81 minutes (95% CI 3.76-3.85); Table 7 prints 1.5 + LOGN(1.86, 1.32), whereas Appendix 2 prints 1.5 + LOGN(1.05, 0.848).
data.limitations: The paper gives no erratum located in the publisher/SciELO search. Triage time is 55.07% missing and the fit sample count/window are absent. Neither printed expression can be selected from the article alone; implied means differ from the reported empirical mean.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Retain both expressions as conflicting source reports for audit only; do not choose either as a calibrated distribution or transfer it to RWJ.
data.conflict_resolution: unresolved_source_conflict; convention clarified, fitted input not validated

data.locator: Methods, verification/validation description; Results, Table 8 discussion; Appendix 2, distribution-fit statistics; Appendix 6, observed-versus-simulated Mann-Whitney results.
data.source_setting: One private hospital emergency department in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil; triage and consultation service-time inputs.
data.source_period: Records span 2022-02-01 to 2023-09-30, excluding August 2023; fit sample period not specified.
data.source_n: 130,525 total attendances; triage duration missing 55.07%, consultation duration missing 16.46%; stage fit n not reported.
data.quantity: Fit goodness-of-fit statistics and model validation evidence

value.appendix_2_fit_tests: All four process/shift rows show test values and parenthetical (<0.05) for Kolmogorov-Smirnov and chi-square columns.
value.observed_vs_simulated_comparison: Body says observed and simulated stage/total means differed significantly; Appendix 6 reports p<0.05 for all listed comparisons.

data.unit: test statistics and reported p-value thresholds
data.source_evidence_basis: Publisher PDF inspected. The appendix presents numerical fit-test statistics with parenthetical <0.05 annotations; these are not clearly labeled p-values in the table structure. Separately, the article describes validation against observed process lengths of stay and reports significant differences (p<0.05).
data.limitations: No inspected body statement saying fit-test p-values exceed 0.05 was located; the Appendix 2 formatting itself leaves the interpretation of the parentheses and values unclear. Validation comparisons concern process lengths of stay, not proof that fitted input distributions fit. No public correction/supplement was found in targeted journal/SciELO search.
data.inferred_scenario_use: Do not claim the input distributions passed goodness-of-fit or that the simulation was validated to observed stage timing. Separate input fit diagnostics from downstream model validation.
